Pavoloch Oldest Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Zhytomyr Oblast, Ukraine

Demolished. Pavoloch suffered a severe blood libel in 1753, in which 13 Jews — including the town's own rabbi, R. Akiva — were executed, the same year a nearly identical fate befell 13 Jews in nearby Zhytomyr, documented elsewhere in this collection. This is the oldest of Pavoloch's three Jewish cemeteries, its burials discontinued in the early 20th century when a new cemetery opened; it was demolished after WWII and became a market square. In the 21st century, a monument was built here honoring R. Aharon Titeiver and the blood libel martyrs of Pavoloch.
